newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Red Roof Inns Q2 revs, net rise.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Red Roof Inns Q2 revs, net rise.

text.p: Second Quarter Ended Six Months Ended
NOTES: (a) Includes non-recurring inn renewal program expenses of $4,770 and $9,541 ($2,897 and $5,796 after tax) for Q2 and six months.
(b) Includes SFAS No. 121 non-recurring charge of $450 ($268 after tax) to recognize impairment of certain long-lived assets.

(c) Includes an extraordinary expense of $746, net of tax, associated with refinancing of bank credit facility and related write-off of unamortized loan fees and, as noted above, non-recurring inn renewal program expenses. (d) Pro forma to exclude in 1997 non-recurring expenses relating to the inn renewal program and extraordinary expense for refinancing of bank credit facility, and in 1996 the SFAS No. 121 adjustment and to give effect to the offering of 10,000 shares of common stock on January 31, 1996 and the application of net proceeds to reduce certain mortgage debt and related interest expense of $1,322 ($787 after tax).
Full co name is Red Roof Inns Inc.
